2026 marks the first year in which the Company has won governmental tenders as a leading prime contractor


Rehovot, Israel, Nov. 09, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK) (“Maris- Tech” or the “Company”), a B2B provider of edge computing artificial intelligence (AI) accelerated video solutions for edge platforms, today announced that the Company’s order backlog as of November 8, 2026, reached a record high of approximately $11,000,000.


The Company defines backlog as the accumulation of all pending orders with a later fulfillment date for which revenue has not been recognized and the Company considers valid. The backlog consists of executed purchase orders from new and existing customers with which we have had long-standing relationships and from governmental agencies.


Revenue from orders included in backlog will generally be recognized upon satisfaction of the Company’s applicable performance obligations, and backlog is not necessarily indicative of future revenues or earnings.


“We are very pleased with the successes of 2026, gaining new and repeat business that is also reflected in a record backlog of orders. We believe that our record backlog reflects the continued demand for our innovative defense and AI-powered solutions. We eagerly anticipate meeting the challenges, expectations and goals of 2027,” said Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech.
